en.name: JSON Schema Validator
en.short: Validate JSON against a JSON Schema and see exactly which field fails.
en.title: JSON Schema validator online (draft-07, 2020-12)
en.description: Validate a JSON document against a JSON Schema (draft-07, 2019-09 or 2020-12) and see exactly which field fails and why, underlined in the data. Can also generate a schema from an example JSON. Powered by Ajv, 100% in your browser.
en.lead: Paste a schema and some data: every error is listed by path and underlined in the data.
en.hint: Paste a schema on top and the data below, or load the example.
en.valid: The data is valid against the schema.

errors.data: The data is not valid JSON.
